label: Finding-23
title: affected-sites: Note "Not captured from any of the named organisations" is out of date
description: The vault holds operator captures: unige.ch returned HTTP 503 with an F5 "under maintenance" page at 2026-10-22 08:19:10Z (unige-site) and 08:19:43Z (ch-unige-down); nord.gouv.fr and rhone.gouv.fr served "Maintenance en cours" at 08:19:39-40Z; edinburgh.gov.uk was up (HTTP 200, normal homepage) at 08:19:03Z and 08:19:40Z; wikimediastatus.net showed "All Systems Operational" at 08:18:50Z. These show down/up state at capture time, not the reason. story.json repeats the out-of-date statement ("has not been captured from any of those organisations").
